verdict.rationale: Jan is itself an AI assistant app, and its docs describe handing it tasks to complete autonomously across files, commands and web research. It also offers custom assistants, MCP tool use with per-call approval, and browser automation through Jan Browser MCP. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous task delegation, and in-depth docs on how the autonomous agent mode works beyond tagline-level claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Give Jan a task and it works on it autonomously — files, commands, and web research.
Custom Assistants: Create specialized AI assistants for your tasks
Model Context Protocol: MCP integration for agentic capabilities
Approval panels appear inline inside the tool card in the chat, showing the exact arguments the model wants to pass before you accept or deny.
